related_questions.question: How does Arkansas property tax work?
related_questions.snippet: Property Tax Rates in Arkansas Tax rates in Arkansas are applied in terms of mills. A mill is equal to 1/1,000, or one tenth of a percent. So if your tax rate is 30 mills and your assessed value is $20,000, your property tax bill would be $600. That's $20,000 x (30/1,000).
